Ability One: The Moon and The Turtle Myoukakami has two forms: the human form and the true form. To remain balanced, it swaps between these two forms every cycle. Human Form (The Moon): When in this form, Myoukakami receives two extra vote parchments. They can either keep the parchments to themselves or share one with another herald. True Form (The Turtle): When in this form, Myoukakami is on defense to protect themselves. They can block up to two vote parchments against themselves.
